Measurement-error-corrected inter-region connectivity and PPI via REPAIR

Source: R/diagnose_crossrun_recovery.R
decon_connectivity_repair.Rd

Estimates trial-by-trial seed-to-target neural connectivity, directed lagged connectivity (controlling for baseline target activity at the seed lag), and task-modulated psychophysiological interactions (PPI) from a decon_epoch_regression trial panel using the REPAIR modified method-of-moments (M-MOMS / M-MOM) framework of Vig & Hallquist (2026). Propagates per-trial operator standard errors (se_demixed) into exact heteroscedastic predictor and outcome error covariances,including the rank-1 interaction error block for PPI (seed * x) and dual predictor error variances for Granger-style auto-lag controls (targ_t0).

Usage

decon_connectivity_repair(
  panel_dt,
  seed_region,
  target_region,
  seed_lag = 0,
  target_lag = 0,
  covariates = NULL,
  test_ppi = FALSE,
  control_target_seed_lag = FALSE,
  orthogonalize_seed_x = TRUE,
  method = c("mmoms", "mmom", "eb_predictor", "naive_gls", "naive_unweighted"),
  use_whitened = NULL,
  region_col = NULL,
  id_col = "id",
  return_augmented_panel = FALSE
)

Arguments

panel_dt

A data.frame or data.table returned in $panel by decon_epoch_regression.

seed_region

Character scalar naming the seed region/parcel/voxel.

target_region

Character scalar naming the target region/parcel/voxel.

seed_lag

Numeric lag (in seconds) for the seed readout (default 0).

target_lag

Numeric lag (in seconds) for the target readout (default 0).

covariates

Optional character vector of error-free trial covariate columns in panel_dt. Defaults to "x" when present in panel_dt, or character(0) otherwise.

test_ppi

Logical; if TRUE, includes the interaction between the seed readout and the first covariate in covariates (seed_c:x_c) with exact per-trial interaction error covariance \(\tilde{\psi}_{S,j} [1, x_{c,j}; x_{c,j}, x_{c,j}^2]\). Default: FALSE.

control_target_seed_lag

Logical; if TRUE and abs(target_lag - seed_lag) > 1e-6, includes the target region's readout at seed_lag (targ_t0_val) as an error-prone control covariate with measurement-error variance se_demixed^2. Default: FALSE.

orthogonalize_seed_x

Logical; if TRUE (default), residualizes the run-centered seed readout on the error-free covariates within each subject-run and scales the seed error variance by \(1 - h_{x,r,j}\) prior to forming PPI interactions, preventing quadratic task drive (\(x_c^2\)) from confounding physiological-by-psychological interactions.

method

Estimation method: "mmoms" (default; adaptive step-up REPAIR M-MOMS), "mmom" (fixed minimum-regularization REPAIR M-MOM), "eb_predictor" (Skrondal & Laake 2001 role-specific Empirical-Bayes shrunk predictor on likelihood-only outcome), "naive_gls" (precision-weighted WLS without predictor error subtraction), or "naive_unweighted" (unweighted OLS).

use_whitened

Logical; if TRUE, uses decon_demixed_whitened and se_whitened when present. Defaults to FALSE for "mmoms" and "mmom" (so elementwise PPI products are formed on unmixed trial states before error correction) and TRUE for "naive_gls".

region_col

Optional column name identifying regions/parcels/voxels in panel_dt (auto-detected from "region", "parcel", "voxel").

id_col

Column name identifying subjects in panel_dt (default "id").

return_augmented_panel

Logical; if TRUE, returns the merged trial panel augmented with moment-preserving REPAIR predictor columns (seed_repair, ppi_repair, repair_weight) that reproduce subject-level M-MOMS slopes in weighted least squares / lmer().

Value

A list of class "medusa_connectivity_repair" containing group (group-level random-effects meta-analytic inference table), subjects (per-subject estimates, SEs, and REPAIR diagnostics), optional panel_repair, and settings.
